page.overview:
Who is Alfred Blacking?

Alfred Blacking is a minor character who appears briefly the 1964 film Goldfinger. He is portrayed by Victor Brooks.

Alfred Blacking is the manager of the golf club where he introduces Auric Goldfinger to James Bond so may play a round of golf together, noting that Bond was an old member of the club, and that he had the same handicap as Goldfinger. As Bond and Goldfinger departed, Blacking noted to Bond that Hawker would serve as his caddy, which Bond accepted, before Goldfinger requested some tees from Blacking.
